summary: Caledonia Mining Corporation Plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated November 5, 2026, announcing that subsidiary Caledonia Holdings Zimbabwe signed an interim financing facilities agreement of up to US$150 million for the Bilboes Gold Project. The facility, arranged by Stanbic Bank Zimbabwe and CBZ Bank and syndicated across eight Zimbabwean lenders, comprises a US$50 million revolving tranche at SOFR plus 8.10% and a US$100 million term tranche at SOFR plus 7.90% with a US$50 million accordion, a 36-month tenor with a one-year extension option. This is a routine project-financing arrangement, not a special situation.
